description: This file is a shell script defining shared functions for CI (Continuous Integration) scripts across different CI environments such as GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. It includes functions for grouping logs, skipping rebuilds based on git trees, handling build artifacts, and configuring environment variables and tools based on the CI platform.

methods.name: skip_branch_tip_with_tag
methods.description: Skips the CI build if the current branch is exactly at a tag and therefore likely unnecessary to build again.

methods.name: is_usable_git_repository
methods.description: Checks if the provided directory is a valid git repository and whether Git is available in PATH.

methods.name: save_good_tree
methods.description: Stores the current git tree hash to a file to potentially skip future builds if the tree hasn't changed.

methods.name: skip_good_tree
methods.description: Checks if the current git tree has been previously built and tested successfully, and skips the build if so.

methods.name: check_unignored_build_artifacts
methods.description: Ensures there are no unignored build artifacts in the repository, indicating a clean working state.

methods.name: handle_failed_tests
methods.description: Placeholder function to handle failed tests, currently always returns failure.

methods.name: create_failed_test_artifacts
methods.description: Generates artifacts from failed tests, including logs and output files, and packages them for review.
